summary: Interpreted the isolation receipt and closed the containment question. Receipt d2973ec8cc524a9089c63dd046e1a4ff evaluated all four comparisons as declared: the feature-enabled node, whose configuration is empty, was isolated from every peer for a second and never entered candidate or leader state (zero configured servers, campaigning not observed), while the control holding {A,B,C} became a candidate under the same isolation (three configured servers, campaigning observed) — so the isolation is a real trigger and the empty configuration is what keeps the defective node from campaigning, which is the guard at raft.go 225-246 refusing to start an election while latestIndex is zero. Both nodes kept their term across the window, which the pre-vote extension explains (a candidate pre-votes before incrementing its term), so that operand is recorded but never asserted. The experiment-level interpretation is holds with no defect judgment of its own; the child question's account was rewritten so the refusal to campaign is now an executed observation rather than a source-derived one, with a joint history across its two receipts, and the only remaining source-derived element is the vote side — a node with an empty configuration skips the membership check in requestVote and would grant votes to candidates it cannot evaluate. Limits kept: construction-state observation with a 300 ms settle, harness-arranged absence of snapshots rather than a store failure, a one-second transport-only isolation with no vote solicitation, and in-memory stores with scaled timeouts.
